title: Measured-return placement harness: environment, fixture and keys, scorecard version, measured-return values, freshness cut-off and gate are not specified, the map publishes no allocation or scorecard read, the InstructionRequest shape is not published, and the legacy endpoint table names R and U where the placement declares C
source: 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md §R7.3 and §R9; _work/msr/wp/B-ITG-W4-05.md; 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md RWB-E6-031 lines 11983-12062; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S9 Partner management v2.md lines 197-244
description: RWB-ITG-E6031-ITG needs four sets of values no source gives. (a) The harness environment and base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic partners, cases and instruction keys, the scorecard version, the measured-return values that rank A first on business date 2027-04-30 and B first on the next business date, the capacity state of the three partners, the business date and the next business date, the freshness cut-off that decides that DP11 is stale, the evidence format and its retention, and the pass or fail gate at the wave entry check. (b) The Ownership Map publishes no allocation read and no scorecard read, so the pick can only be asserted through the instruction S9 issues, the measured return through DP08 and the score through DP11; the story must never invent an allocation endpoint to make the assertion cleaner. (c) The InstructionRequest body shape of API-S9-002 is not published, so the body the run sends is held in the fixture from S9's CON story and only the published PartnerInstruction response fields are asserted. (d) The legacy endpoint table of RWB-E6-031 names Partner portal R on GET /partner/instructions and Partner portal U on POST /partner/instructions/{instructionId}/results, while the published placement operation POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions declares Partner portal C; the story follows the published matrix and records the legacy table as the earlier read and result paths.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E6-031 (User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3, lines 11983-12062) names the feature, the data entities, two partner-portal endpoints, SCR-34 and SCR-35, the permission checks, three messages and TC-E6-031-01 to TC-E6-031-04, and states no environment, fixture, key scheme, scorecard version, measured-return value, capacity state, freshness cut-off, evidence format or gate. TSD S9 v2 lines 197-244 publish API-S9-002 POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions with purpose 'Issue an instruction to a partner by rule', request InstructionRequest, response PartnerInstruction, right Partner portal C and an Idempotency-Key, and API-S9-003 GET /partner/instructions with right R, and publish no allocation list, no scorecard read and no InstructionRequest field list. ownership.json holds only S9 POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions and GET /partner/instructions, P1 GET /data-products/{productCode}/records and GET /data-products/freshness, P3 GET /cases/{caseId}, P7 GET /decision-log and P4 GET /me/session, and no allocation read. FSD S9 A2.3 (lines 257-326) gives the steps, VR-S9-003-1 with MSG-P1-001, BR-S9-003 and the roles, and no harness detail; Business Requirements Program v4 line 432 (REQ-S9-003) gives the rule; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 lines 361 and 362 (R-WO-30, R-WO-31) give 'same day on the portal' and 'hold the placement' and define no cut-off; FSD P1 lines 290 and 293 give DP08 on change and DP11 daily at 08:00 and no stale threshold; Arch v5 slides 17 and 41 (lines 1245-1256, 1270-1272, 2891) and slide 43 row 20 (line 2946) give the contract and the event; Temporal design slide 25 (lines 1663-1755) gives the scorecard pick, the instruction and the clocks; Template and Rules v1 §R7.3 lists the fill order and none of its sources holds these values.
area: Integration harness configuration and published contract gaps for S9 allocation by measured return
proposed: Agree at the wave 4 entry check: SIT with the base hosts, the fixture layout and the synthetic partners PRT-SYN-0031-A, PRT-SYN-0031-B and PRT-SYN-0031-C with cases RW-2027-000831 and RW-2027-000832, the scorecard version, the measured-return values for business date 2027-04-30 and the next business date, the capacity state, the freshness cut-off, the evidence format and retention and a gate in which a stub pass is never a real pass; keep the pick asserted through the instruction, DP08 and DP11 and add no allocation endpoint; hold the InstructionRequest body in the fixture from S9's CON story; and read the placement right as Partner portal C per API-S9-002, with the legacy table's R and U recorded as the earlier read and result paths.
